about: THE SEA MOVES HER (Code/Game/Voyage/SeaPush.cs, Adrift.cs, RoughWaters.cs; the user, 9 Oct 2026: 'We need an intelligent realistic current and weather system that can blow and push the ship off course and rough ocean areas'; by the picker: 'Always adrift' and 'Strained and held off'). EVERY NUMBER IS A STARTING GUESS TO TUNE. A name left out keeps the number in the code. on: false and nothing carries her, as before. tide: the tide's stream times this (1: as reckoned from the tide model); tideMost: the most it may run, m/s. leewayBeating / Reaching / Running: degrees she is set sideways under sail with the wind forward of 60 degrees off the bow / on the beam / abaft it, at leewayWind m/s of wind (more in more wind), never over leewayMost. windageBare / LyingTo: the share of the wind's speed she is blown downwind at with no sail drawing / lying to. seaShare, seaTurn: the top of the sea runs at this share of the wind, this many degrees to the right of it. offLineWarnM: metres off her line at which the log says so and the clock drops. landfallM: metres at which the steersman sees the end of his open water and steers for it (30 km: as far as the chart shows her what is round her); landfallNight: the share of that by night. coastEye / coastEyeNight: along a coast he finds out this share of his error an hour. anchorDepthM: lying to in water no deeper than this, and no gale, she lies to her anchor and is not carried. shoreStrainHour / Gale: what an hour held off a shore costs the hull when she cannot keep clear; clawOff: how many times the push her own way must be to keep clear. roughSeas: litres an hour over the gunwale where the roughness is 1; roughWear: the hull's wear an hour there; roughSlow: the share of her speed she keeps there.
